feature.name: Version and encoding declaration
feature.description: XML documents can begin with a prolog specifying version (typically 1.0 or 1.1) and encoding, aiding parsers.

feature.name: ID/IDREF/IDREFS type support
feature.description: Built-in schema types for defining unique identifiers and references between elements (often used for internal linking and integrity).

feature.name: External entity inclusion
feature.description: Permits inclusion of external resources (e.g., DTD subsets, parsed/unparsed entities) via external entity references.
